document_kind_scope.name: document_kind_scope
document_kind_scope.value: ("documents"."kind" IN ('manual','sop') AND "documents"."asset_id" IS NULL) OR ("documents"."kind" = 'maintenance_report' AND "documents"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "documents"."kind" = 'reference'

spill_fields_correspond.name: spill_fields_correspond
spill_fields_correspond.value: ("inspections"."spill_detected" AND "inspections"."spill_area_pct" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."spill_volume_bbl" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "inspections"."spill_detected" AND "inspections"."spill_area_pct" IS NULL AND "inspections"."spill_volume_bbl" IS NULL)

spill_ranges.name: spill_ranges
spill_ranges.value: ("inspections"."spill_area_pct" IS NULL OR "inspections"."spill_area_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND ("inspections"."spill_volume_bbl" IS NULL OR "inspections"."spill_volume_bbl" >= 0)
